articles.title: Gemini Robotics ER 2: powering robotics with video understanding, task orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration
articles.summary: Gemini Robotics ER 2 helps robots reason, collaborate, and solve real-world tasks. It represents a step change in video understanding, tool orchestration, and multi-robot collaboration for robotic applications.
